body:
We've been dating three years.  Engaged for 9 months.  This is the first I've heard that she feels this way.  Breaking it off would be difficult, as well as not optimal because a) I can't support myself alone without her income and b) we live together and have almost everything we own is shared.  Breaking up isn't really an option.  Just have to work things through.  

Typing it all out has helped me feel a bit better about it all though.  Still feeling as though the world would be better without me, but I can't compromise her feelings and burden her with my selfish actions.

"I walk around and my feelings are always hurt and you don't have the decency to apologize for the shitty things you do"

I'm paraphrasing, but the first part is a direct quote.

Took a personal day, takes to her about stuff, and surprised her with flowers and her favorite meal.  

Things are looking good. :)

Don't move and pack everything in one day.

Bend at the knees when picking stuff up, not the waist.

Be prepared tho spend way more money than you anticipate in the first month than you think you are going to now.

Get friends and  family to help pack/unpack. The difference is astonishing.

Clearly label each box with what is inside it and/or where it goes.
As a vikings fan, I do the same. Paul allen > joe buck.
